documents.content_summary: Survey paper A comprehensive survey on large language models for multimedia data security: challenges and solutions Ankit Kumar a, Mikail Mohammed Salim a, David Camacho b , Jong Hyuk Park a,* a Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Seoul National University of Science and Technology (SeoulTech), Seoul 0l8ll, South Korea b Department of Computer Systems and Engineering, Technical University of Madrid, Spain A R T I C L E I N F O Keywords: Large language models Multimedia data security Data privacy LLM attacks LLM vulnerabilities A B S T R A C T The rapid expansion of IoT applications utilizes multimedia data integrated with Large Language Models (LLMs) for interpreting digital information by leveraging the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) driven neural network systems.  These models are extensively used as generative AI tools for data augmentation but data se­ curity and privacy remain a fundamental concern associated with LLM model in the digital domain.  Traditional security approach shows potential challenges in addressing emerging threats such as adversarial attacks, data poisoning, or privacy breaches, especially in dynamic and resource-constrained IoT environments.
